value.body: Reproduced on the reference DAC at 96 kHz. Buffer underruns line up with the crackle.
Could this be the ring buffer refactor? @daniel to check the timings.
Bisected to the commit that changed `frames_per_period` to 256.
Same symptom on the Linux build, so it is not driver-specific.
Confirmed, the timings regress after that commit.
Assigning to the current cycle; fix before the beta cut.
I drafted an outline before leaving; it is in the shared drive.
Background sync works on Wi-Fi; cellular still pauses downloads.
Cellular downloads are gated by the data-saver setting, that is expected.
Exported the IAM report; three stale grants found so far.
Stack trace points at the widget's state restoration.
